m14.text: In the legend, the Sister and her brother become the new lords of the castle when a scout returns to announce that the knights are all dead and the necromancer's army will arrive within hours.
They ride out in armor to avenge their parents, but at the necromancer's monastery lair the brother freezes in fear at the entry, and the Sister goes in alone, driven forward by their pact.
She returns as an undead horror with a blade through her belly, pulls it free and strikes down her brother.
